subject: POC capacity supplement request — IngestAI latency/throughput soak
messages:
From: Alex Chang <alex@ingestai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@ingestai.com>, procurement@ingestai.com
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary capacity for POC soak (May 1-3)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile. We have a narrowed POC plan to validate sustained throughput and tail latency over a multi-day soak. High-level ask: can Redwood provision a short-term capacity/credit supplement for our POC so we can run a realistic QPS ramp?

Quick details:
- Test window: May 1 08:00 UTC — May 3 20:00 UTC
- Target sustained QPS: ~1,200 requests/sec (avg request ~650 tokens)
- SLA targets we’ll validate: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 250ms, end-to-end 99.9% success
- Expected token consumption (estimate): ~78,000 tokens/day, ~234,000 tokens total

We don’t yet have enterprise wiring in place; a temporary trial extension or promotional credit (one-time) would let us complete the soak and finalize sizing. Can you confirm what you can offer (token top-up, short promo voucher, or ephemeral Dedicated slot for the window)? I attached our load plan and request matrix.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the ramp.

— Alex
Alex Chang
Head of Integrations, IngestAI
alex@ingestai.com

Attachment: ingestai_load_plan.csv (CSV with QPS schedule, payload sizes)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chang <alex@ingestai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity for POC soak (May 1-3)

Hi Alex — appreciate the details and the load plan. Looping in Ben and Marissa to approve a short-term top-up. A couple quick questions to help sizing:
- Is the 1,200 QPS steady-state or peak? (we should plan for peaks ~1.5x)
- Any bursty patterns that require concurrent KV-cache warm starts?

Tentative offer from my side: we can provide a one-time promo credit to cover the estimated tokens + 20% headroom, or we can grant a temporary quota bump for the May 1–3 window. Ben — is there room to approve a 280k token top-up or a 72-hour promo code tied to the IngestAI account? If so, we’ll send usage instructions and an on-call for run support (Dylan can monitor the run).

Alex — if that works, confirm the test window and whether you want the credit or the explicit quota edit.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0179
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity for POC soak (May 1-3)

Agree to provisionally approve.
- Approve one-time credit: 300,000 tokens (covers their estimate + ~28% buffer)
- Issue a 72-hour promo voucher tied to the IngestAI account, valid only for May 1 00:00 UTC — May 4 00:00 UTC
- Provide run-day on-call from Dylan (he’s cc’d) for monitoring and quick config tweaks

Note: please log the quota change and voucher issuance in the deal record (HubSpot RDW-2027-1185) and mark as “promo-assisted POC”. Finance will reconcile usage against promotional bucket.

Ben
Director, Commercial Operations
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chang <alex@ingestai.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity for POC soak (May 1-3)

Alex — good news: we approved the request.

Summary of what we’ve provisioned for IngestAI (RDW-2027-1185):
- One-time token credit: 300,000 tokens applied to your account (visible in Console > Billing)
- 72-hour promo voucher: PROMO-INGEST-72H (valid May 1 00:00 UTC — May 4 00:00 UTC)
- Run support: Dylan Brooks will be on-call for the window; he can join a run-day channel and assist with any config or fallback routing.

Action items for you:
1) Confirm you’ll run the soak starting May 1 (we’ve already applied the credit and enabled the voucher).
2) Share any last-minute changes to the schedule or payload sizes so Dylan can pre-configure the monitoring hooks.

Helpful links: Console quota page: https://app.redwood.ai/console/quotas/ingestai — we also added a one-off usage dashboard for the account.

If anything goes sideways on the run, ping Dylan directly (dylan.brooks@redwood.com) or open a support thread and mark priority P0. Good luck on the validation — looking forward to your feedback.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_promo_voucher.pdf (promo code and terms)
